answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 10 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The signal counter is kept in basalt and spiral exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 10 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 259 aliases cost 95 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
